levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب

notes: The two remarks of the compiler («روى هذا الحديث الأعمش ...», «وروى سفيان الثوري ...») each name other transmitters from Abu Ishaq: two variant groups, not routes of the main isnad.
The variant that begins at الأعمش has no shaykh of the compiler: the remark starts at the transmitters of Abu Ishaq.
«سألت محمدا» (the compiler asking Bukhari's opinion) is not a link of this saying; «وفي الباب» names Companions for other reports: both left out.
